meta.name: Store, deterministic benchmark
meta.description: Spec 2 benchmark store, deterministic: one arrival every 6 min from 0 into a store of initial 100 with reorder_point 30, order_quantity 100 and a constant lead time of 123 min, then a sink. Each item takes one unit; an order is placed when stock on hand plus on order falls to 30, after 70 withdrawals (at 414 min) and then every 100 (every 600 min); each arrives 123 min later, with 10 on hand, never at a demand instant.
